resources.string: Your name, email and a password.
Shown to the people you talk to
Enter an email address like name@example.com
Your password can\'t be your email address
This server needs one to sign up
With your Meldiq email and password.
Used Orbit or Griip Message before email sign-in? Use your username and recovery key once.
Want to use a different account?
This deletes the signed-out account\'s keys, messages and files from this phone. Without its recovery key or another signed-in phone, its encrypted history can\'t be read here again.
We sent a 6-digit code to %1$s. It expires in 15 minutes.
Not there? Check your spam folder.
The password you chose for this account
If this address is waiting for a code, a new one is on its way.
We\'ll email you a code to choose a new password.
If an account uses this address, a code is on its way.
Enter the code sent to %1$s. Every signed-in app will need the new password.
Password changed. Sign in with the new one.
You\'re signed in. This phone needs your account\'s keys to finish signing in.
A phone already signed in approves this one
The key you saved when you created your account
No key and no other phone: new keys, old encrypted history lost
It stays on this phone: it\'s checked here and turned into your account\'s key, never sent.
Your other phones will be signed out, encrypted history stored on the server will be deleted, and contacts will see that your security code changed. Your communities, groups and contacts stay.
A new phone usually needs only your password and a code sent to your email. If you lose that email or reset your password, this key is the way to read your messages again.
Keep it offline (on paper or in a password manager). Anyone with it can read your encrypted history.
How do you want to start?
You can switch communities any time, and use Meldiq personally without a community.
Direct messages, groups and contacts in your personal community
Set up your team\'s community; you\'ll be its owner
With an invitation code or link
You can add branches, teams and channels next
Accounts now use email and a password. Move yours once; your chats, groups and communities come with it.
Your recovery key proves the account is yours. It\'s checked on this phone and never sent or stored. On a signed-in phone it\'s under Settings › Privacy & Security › Recovery key & safety numbers.
Choose the email and password you\'ll sign in with from now on.
Your other apps will need to sign in again
Messages stay on this phone for when you sign in again
You\'ll need your email and password to sign in again. Your encrypted messages stay on this phone; to remove them, use Sign out & erase.
Erase your account and its data from the server
This deletes the Meldiq account %1$s for good. You leave every community, group and channel, every device is signed out and your profile is erased. It can\'t be undone.
People you messaged keep the conversation, shown as \"Deleted account\". Messages already delivered stay on their devices.
Once the server confirms, this phone erases its copy of the account too.
Type your account\'s email address exactly. Nothing was deleted.
That password isn\'t right. Nothing was deleted.
You\'re the only owner of %1$s. Make someone else an owner, or delete it, first. Nothing was deleted.
This server can\'t delete accounts yet. Nothing was deleted.
Couldn\'t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Something went wrong, and your account may not have been deleted. Try again.
